sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: Approved alternatives (4) with relationship reasons — not a random category list.

sections.heading: Alternatives
sections.body:
apollo: relevant because Apollo offers similar data-plus-engagement consolidation with a free tier — better when you want to evaluate without a paid trial clock; better when that tradeoff fits; worse when the source product's strengths matter more.
amplemarket: relevant because Amplemarket is a closer AI-first outbound peer when autonomous SDR workflows matter more than Reply's published Email Volume ladder; better when that tradeoff fits; worse when the source product's strengths matter more.
closely: relevant because Closely is a strong LinkedIn+email automation alternative with clearer mid-market list pricing for agency/white-label outbound; better when that tradeoff fits; worse when the source product's strengths matter more.
lusha: relevant because Lusha is the better swap when you mainly need contact data and enrichment, not multichannel sequencing; better when that tradeoff fits; worse when the source product's strengths matter more.

sections.heading: Decision guidance
sections.body: Use comparison pages for pairwise decisions; do not invent superiority.

faq.question: Is this alternatives page based on live vendor verification?

faq.answer: No. This draft is based on our evaluation of research evidence, not personal product usage.
